raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- `get_swa_out_cache_loc` in the DeepSeek V4 CUDA and HIP backends returns for an idle forward before it reads `forward_metadata`, which an idle forward may leave stale or unset: the request window's idle layout (`RequestWindow.activate_idle`) when there is one, else the zero-padded `out_cache_loc` translated to the dummy slot, as idle already used. The later `not is_idle()` check goes away.
- HIP: with `--enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay`, an idle forward read the request-window layout of a stale or unset `forward_metadata`, the crash #45586 fixed on CUDA; it now takes the idle layout.
- CUDA and HIP without a request window: an idle forward whose stale metadata still carried a `late_layer_tail` returned that tail's store locations, sized for another batch; it now takes the dummy slot. Whether a stale tail reaches an idle forward was not traced.
- Verified on CUDA: GB300, DEP4 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with MegaMoE and DSPARK, GSM8K (sgl-eval, 200 examples) 97.00% with encoder SWA bounded replay and 97.50% without, no scheduler exception. The HIP change is untested on hardware.

No behavior change outside idle forwards.

raw_graphql_pull_request.title: [Fix] dsv4: Never read attention metadata for idle SWA stores

detail.body:
- `get_swa_out_cache_loc` in the DeepSeek V4 CUDA and HIP backends returns for an idle forward before it reads `forward_metadata`, which an idle forward may leave stale or unset: the request window's idle layout (`RequestWindow.activate_idle`) when there is one, else the zero-padded `out_cache_loc` translated to the dummy slot, as idle already used. The later `not is_idle()` check goes away.
- HIP: with `--enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay`, an idle forward read the request-window layout of a stale or unset `forward_metadata`, the crash #45586 fixed on CUDA; it now takes the idle layout.
- CUDA and HIP without a request window: an idle forward whose stale metadata still carried a `late_layer_tail` returned that tail's store locations, sized for another batch; it now takes the dummy slot. Whether a stale tail reaches an idle forward was not traced.
- Verified on CUDA: GB300, DEP4 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with MegaMoE and DSPARK, GSM8K (sgl-eval, 200 examples) 97.00% with encoder SWA bounded replay and 97.50% without, no scheduler exception. The HIP change is untested on hardware.

No behavior change outside idle forwards.

files.patch:
@@ -3950,27 +3950,26 @@ def get_swa_out_cache_loc(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch) -> torch.Tensor:
         """Idle never trusts its metadata, which may be stale or unset: it writes
         the request window's idle layout, or translates the zero-padded
         out_cache_loc to the dummy slot."""
+        out_cache_loc = forward_batch.out_cache_loc
+        window = self.token_to_kv_pool.request_window
+        if forward_batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
+            if window is not None:
+                return window.activate_idle(out_cache_loc.shape[0])
+            return self.token_to_kv_pool.translate_loc_from_full_to_swa(
+                out_cache_loc
+            ).to(torch.int32)
         metadata = self.forward_metadata
-        if self.token_to_kv_pool.request_window is not None:
-            if forward_batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
-                return self.token_to_kv_pool.request_window.activate_idle(
-                    forward_batch.out_cache_loc.shape[0]
-                )
+        if window is not None:
             layout = metadata.core_attn_metadata.request_window_layout
-            self.token_to_kv_pool.request_window.activate(layout)
+            window.activate(layout)
             return layout.write_loc
         if isinstance(metadata, DSV4Metadata) and metadata.late_layer_tail is not None:
             # The tail's q rows are a subset of the extend, so the full
             # out_cache_loc below would be the wrong length; the tail owns its own.
             return metadata.late_layer_tail.swa_out_cache_loc
-        out_cache_loc = forward_batch.out_cache_loc
         core = getattr(self.forward_metadata, "core_attn_metadata", None)
         cached = core.swa_out_cache_loc if core is not None else None
-        if (
-            cached is not None
-            and not forward_batch.forward_mode.is_idle()
-            and cached.shape[0] == out_cache_loc.shape[0]
-        ):
+        if cached is not None and cached.shape[0] == out_cache_loc.shape[0]:
